newsitem.title: USA: Nu-West sued by preferred stockholder.
newsitem.headline: Nu-West sued by preferred stockholder.

text.p: A Nu-West Industries Inc preferred shareholder has filed a class-action suit seeking damages related to the company's redemption of class A preferred shares on December 13.

In papers filed Friday in the Delaware Chancery Court, shareholder Andrew Shapiro alleges that the redemption deprived preferred shareholders of accumulated dividends. The suit also alleges the directors breached their fiduciary duty with their efforts to depress the value of the Class A preferred stock.
In a statement last month, Nu-West said it would redeem the class A shares at $100 par value plus all accrued and unpaid dividends of $71.50.
Defendants include Nu-West, its board, Agrium U.S. Inc of Colorado and Agrium Inc of Canada.
A spokesman for Nu-West, an Englewood, Colorado-based producer of phosphate fertilizers, was unavailable for comment.
